metadata.description: Agent skills for working with Hex's AI agents and analytics platform.

plugins.name: artifact-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Claude Artifacts (claude.ai HTML/React pages — dashboards, trackers, calculators, prototypes) into Hex. Unlike the BI migrations the source has no warehouse behind it, so this skill leads with a data-grounding gate that maps every number onto a real warehouse column — mock data never ships — then lets Hex's notebook agent build a generative app on gated SQL cells, verified with a SQL-fidelity gate (including a mock-constant sweep) and a visual-QA loop.

plugins.name: context-management
plugins.description: Build, manage, and improve the context that makes Hex's AI agents (Threads, Notebook Agent, Modeling Agent) accurate — endorsements, warehouse descriptions, workspace context, guides, and semantic models — then measure it with a dedicated eval engine that authors and runs eval suites, sources cases from real usage, and gates changes in a hex context preview. Publish via GitHub sync or the Hex CLI. Routes to the specific workflow instead of running full setup each time.

plugins.name: looker-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Looker dashboards/Looks into Hex: translate LookML + Looker's generated SQL, let Hex's notebook agent build a generative app on gated SQL cells, and verify with a SQL-fidelity gate (numeric parity vs Looker) + a visual-QA loop.

plugins.name: mode-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Mode (Mode Analytics / ThoughtSpot Mode) reports into Hex: pull the report via the Mode API, translate the Mode-specific layers (Liquid params, definitions, dataset refs, Python/R notebooks) into a migration brief, let Hex's notebook agent build a generative app on gated SQL cells, and verify with a SQL-fidelity gate + a visual-QA loop.

plugins.name: mode-migration-classic
plugins.description: Migrate Mode (Mode Analytics / ThoughtSpot Mode) reports into Hex as a classic app — native cells (SQL, input parameters, EXPLORE/METRIC/pivot charts) in an app layout that analysts can maintain with no code. Same brief and SQL-fidelity gate as mode-migration, plus a cell-spec diff over the exported chart specs; pick this over the generative build for Report Builder reports.

plugins.name: tableau-migration
plugins.description: Migrate Tableau dashboards/workbooks into Hex: parse the .twb into a migration brief, let Hex's notebook agent build a generative app on gated SQL cells, and verify with a SQL-fidelity gate + a visual-QA loop.

plugins.name: tableau-migration-classic
plugins.description: Migrate Tableau dashboards/workbooks into Hex as a classic app — native cells (SQL, input parameters, EXPLORE/METRIC/pivot charts) in an app layout that analysts can maintain with no code. Same brief and SQL-fidelity gate as tableau-migration, plus a cell-spec diff over the exported chart specs; table calcs and ratios of aggregates are pre-computed as SQL columns. Pick this when the team wants a dashboard they can edit; pick tableau-migration when pixel fidelity outranks maintainability.
